# Floor & Decor Announces New Store Opening in Florence, KY


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f115c9634c538f5a640963d31696d5a0/flooranddecor/news/2026-10-08_Floor_Decor_Announces_New_Store_Opening_in_304.pdf) October 08, 2026 8:35am EDT


*—Leading high-growth retailer specializing in hard-surface flooring brings its expansive in-stock selection and warehouse-format shopping experience to the Florence, KY area—*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), the leading high-growth retailer specializing in hard-surface flooring for homeowners and professionals, today announced the opening of its newest warehouse store and design center in Florence, Kentucky, located at 87 Spiral Drive.


The Florence store will open with a team of approximately 38 associates and is led by Gena Schobinger, the store's Chief Executive Merchant.


Floor & Decor operates more than 280 warehouse-format stores and five design studios nationwide and offers a broad assortment of in-stock hard-surface flooring, including tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone, along with decorative accessories and wall tile, installation materials, and related categories at everyday low prices.


“Bringing Floor & Decor to Florence is an exciting milestone for our team,” said Schobinger. “For more than 25 years, we’ve focused on making quality, trend-forward hard-surface flooring accessible to everyone, and we’re proud to extend that commitment to this community. We look forward to serving our new customers and helping bring their ideas to life.”


**Grand Opening Celebration** Floor & Decor will celebrate the grand opening of its Florence store on Thursday, October 15, 2026, with a full day of events for homeowners and professionals.


**Ribbon Cutting Ceremony** Floor & Decor will host a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on Thursday, October 15, at 10 a.m. ET, in partnership with the Northern Kentucky Chamber of Commerce.


**PRO Grand Opening Event** That evening, from 5 to 8 p.m. ET, the store will host a PRO Grand Opening Event for local contractors, installers, designers, and other trade professionals. Attendees will have the chance to win prizes including a Chevy Colorado truck, an iPad, an Apple Watch, a Yeti cooler, a Carhartt duffle, and more.


**Store Facts & Features**


- Location: 87 Spiral Drive, Florence, KY 41042
- Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET
- Phone Number: (859) 488-6533


For more information on the PRO Grand Opening events and resources, visit:[www.prograndopening.com/florencepro](http://www.prograndopening.com/florencepro) .


**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.** Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of June 25, 2026, the Company operated 281 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
